name: IDS_ATLAS_ABOUT_VERSION
context: The line of Settings > About that names the version of the browser and of its engine, when the computer is not running WolOS. Example: Version 0.13.0 (Official Build) (64-bit). Engine 156.0.8078.79.

name: IDS_ATLAS_ABOUT_VERSION_WOLOS
context: The line of Settings > About that names the version of the browser, the WolOS release and the engine. Example: Version 0.13.0 (Official Build) (64-bit). WolOS 0.13. Engine 156.0.8078.79.
message: Version <ph name="ATLAS_VERSION">$1<ex>0.13.0</ex></ph> (<ph name="CHANNEL">$2<ex>Official Build</ex></ph>) <ph name="BITS">$3<ex>(64-bit)</ex></ph>. WolOS <ph name="WOLOS_RELEASE">$4<ex>0.13</ex></ph>. Engine <ph name="ENGINE_VERSION">$5<ex>156.0.8078.79</ex></ph>.

name: IDS_ATLAS_ABOUT_LICENSE
context: The sentence below the copyright line of Settings > About. The link goes to the page that lists the licenses of the software inside the browser.
message: Atlas is made possible by open source software. <ph name="BEGIN_LINK"><a target="_blank" href="$1" aria-description="$2"></ph>See the credits<ph name="END_LINK"></a></ph>.

name: IDS_ATLAS_ABOUT_OPENS_IN_NEW_TAB
context: The accessibility description of a link that opens in a new tab.

name: IDS_ATLAS_ABOUT_UPDATES
context: The row of Settings > About that says how the browser is updated. The link after it opens the Software Update pane of WolOS System Settings.

name: IDS_ATLAS_ABOUT_OPEN_UPDATES
context: The link after the sentence about updates in Settings > About. It opens the Software Update pane of WolOS System Settings.

name: IDS_ATLAS_VERSION_WOLOS_LABEL
context: The label of the row of the version page that shows the WolOS release.

name: IDS_ATLAS_VERSION_ENGINE_LABEL
context: The label of the row of the version page that shows the version of the browser engine.

name: IDS_ATLAS_VERSION_NO_WOLOS
context: The value of the WolOS row of the version page when the computer is not running WolOS.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_OPEN_WITH
context: Downloads list, row menu: choose the app that opens the file. The ellipsis says the desktop asks which app.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_SHARE
context: Downloads list, row menu: share the file with the share sheet of the desktop. The ellipsis says the sheet asks where to send it.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_SHOW_IN_FILES
context: Downloads list, row menu: show the file in the file manager of the desktop, which is called Files.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_MOVE_TO_TRASH
context: Downloads list, row menu: move the file to the Trash of the desktop, from where it can be restored. Last in the menu because it removes the file from the folder.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_OPEN_WITH_ACCESSIBLE_NAME
context: Downloads list, row menu, screen reader name of the Open With item. $1 is the file name.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_SHARE_ACCESSIBLE_NAME
context: Downloads list, row menu, screen reader name of the Share item. $1 is the file name.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_SHOW_IN_FILES_ACCESSIBLE_NAME
context: Downloads list, row menu, screen reader name of the Show in Files item. $1 is the file name.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_MENU_MOVE_TO_TRASH_ACCESSIBLE_NAME
context: Downloads list, row menu, screen reader name of the Move to Trash item. $1 is the file name.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOAD_VERB_FAILED_TITLE
context: Title of the box that says Share, Open With or Move to Trash on a downloaded file did not happen. The reason is in the box.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DOWNLOADS_HEADER
context: Heading of the list of downloads that opens from the downloads button of the toolbar.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_PINNED
context: Heading of the row of pinned pages on the new tab page.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_RECENT
context: Heading of the pages the person can go back to on the new tab page.
message: Pick up where you left off

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_PINNED_EMPTY
context: Shown on the new tab page under the Pinned heading when no page is pinned.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_EMPTY_TITLE
context: Title of the empty state that replaces the pick-up cards on the new tab page when there is nothing to go back to.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_EMPTY_HINT
context: One line under the empty state title on the new tab page.
message: Pages you open show up here, so you can come back to them.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_EMPTY_ACTION
context: Button of the empty state on the new tab page. It moves the cursor to the search field.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER
context: Placeholder and name of the search field on the new tab page. The person can type a web address or words to search for.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_OPENED
context: Second line of a pick-up card on the new tab page: when the page was last open. The time reads like '20 minutes ago' or 'yesterday', in the person's language.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_OPENED_JUST_NOW
context: Second line of a pick-up card on the new tab page when the page was open less than a minute ago.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_REMOVE_FROM_PINNED
context: Name of the button on a pinned card that takes the page off the Pinned row.

name: IDS_ATLAS_NEWTAB_REMOVED_FROM_PINNED
context: Said by a screen reader after a page was taken off the Pinned row.

name: IDS_ATLAS_DNT_IS_ON
context: A quiet line at the bottom of the window and of the new tab page, shown while the setting that asks websites not to follow the person is on. Not an action.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_SECTION_PINNED
context: Header of the pinned tabs in the tab sidebar. It is drawn in capital letters.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_SECTION_TODAY
context: Header of the tabs used today in the tab sidebar. It is drawn in capital letters.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_SECTION_YESTERDAY
context: Header of the tabs last used yesterday in the tab sidebar. It is drawn in capital letters.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_SECTION_EARLIER
context: Header of the tabs last used before yesterday in the tab sidebar. It is drawn in capital letters.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_NEW_TAB
context: Label of the row at the bottom of the tab sidebar that opens a new tab.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_NEW_TAB_SHORTCUT
context: The keys that open a new tab, shown at the right of the New tab row of the tab sidebar, written like the WolOS shortcut sheet: the command glyph stands for Super, the key with the WolOS logo.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_UNTITLED_TAB
context: Title of a row of the tab sidebar for a tab that has no title and no address yet.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_GROUP_UNTITLED
context: Name shown in the tab sidebar for a tab group that has no name. It is drawn in capital letters.

name: IDS_ATLAS_SIDEBAR_GROUP_TAB_COUNT
context: Summary of a collapsed tab group in the tab sidebar: how many tabs it holds.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_PRIVACY_TOOLTIP_ON
context: Tooltip and accessible name of the privacy button in the toolbar while Do Not Track is on. Do Not Track is a request that sites may ignore, so the text never says anything is blocked.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_PRIVACY_TOOLTIP_OFF
context: Tooltip and accessible name of the privacy button in the toolbar after the person turned Do Not Track off.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_PRIVACY_TITLE
context: Title of the small window that opens from the privacy button in the toolbar.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_DNT
context: Name of a row in the privacy window: the Do Not Track request.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_DNT_INFO
context: One line under the Do Not Track row: what the setting does.
message: Sites are asked not to follow you. Some sites ignore the request.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_GPC
context: Name of a row in the privacy window: Global Privacy Control, a signal sent to sites.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_GPC_INFO
context: One line under the Global Privacy Control row: what the setting does.
message: Sites are told not to sell or share your data.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_TRACKERS
context: Name of a row in the privacy window: the list-based tracker blocker.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_TRACKERS_INFO
context: One line under the Tracker blocking row: what the setting does.
message: A list built into Atlas stops known trackers from loading.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_NOISE
context: Name of a row in the privacy window: small random changes in what a page can read back from the canvas and audio, so sites cannot use those reads to recognise the person.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_ROW_NOISE_INFO
context: One line under the Fingerprint noise row: what the setting does. Pages still look and sound as the site made them.
message: Adds tiny changes to canvas and audio reads, so sites cannot use them to recognise you. Pages look and sound as made.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_VALUE_ON
context: Value shown at the right of a row in the privacy window when the setting is on.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_VALUE_OFF
context: Value shown at the right of a row in the privacy window when the setting is off.

name: IDS_ATLAS_TOOLBAR_PRIVACY_SETTINGS_LINK
context: Link at the bottom of the privacy window that opens the privacy page of Settings.

name: IDS_ATLAS_VAULT_APP_MENU_PASSWORDS
context: Item in the app menu that opens the saved passwords page.

name: IDS_ATLAS_VAULT_SETTINGS_PASSWORDS
context: Entry in the settings menu that opens the saved passwords page in a new tab.
